title: Among charter schools that are either Active or Closed and located in count
question: Among charter schools that are either Active or Closed and located in counties that contain at least one State Special School (EdOpsCode = 'SSS'), find those with SAT excellence rates above 0.25. Return their charter number, school name, county, and eligible free rate for students aged 5–17, sorted by this rate in descending order.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
    s.XCL_064 AS charter_number,
    s.XCL_047 AS school_name,
    s.XCL_045 AS county,
    f.XCL_025 / f.XCL_024 AS eligible_free_rate
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON f.XCL_001 = s.XCL_041
JOIN satscores t ON t.XCL_030 = s.XCL_041
WHERE s.XCL_063 = 1
  AND s.XCL_044 IN ('Active', 'Closed')
  AND s.XCL_045 IN (SELECT s2.XCL_045 FROM schools s2 WHERE s2.XCL_070 = 'SSS')
  AND CAST(t.XCL_040 AS REAL) / t.XCL_036 > 0.25
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate DESC

SELECT
    s.XCL_064 AS charter_number,
    s.XCL_047 AS school_name,
    s.XCL_045 AS county,
    f.XCL_025 / f.XCL_024 AS eligible_free_rate
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON f.XCL_001 = s.XCL_041
JOIN satscores t ON t.XCL_030 = s.XCL_041
WHERE s.XCL_063 = 1
  AND s.XCL_044 IN ('Active', 'Closed')
  AND s.XCL_045 IN (SELECT s2.XCL_045 FROM schools s2 WHERE s2.XCL_070 = 'SSS')
  AND CAST(t.XCL_040 AS REAL) / t.XCL_036 > 0.25
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate DESC

Output: Charter number (XCL_064), school name (XCL_047), county (XCL_045), and eligible free rate (XCL_025 / XCL_024) are correctly projected and sorted.

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT s.XCL_041, s.XCL_043, s.XCL_045, f.XCL_025 / f.XCL_024 AS eligible_free_rate
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON f.XCL_001 = s.XCL_041
JOIN satscores t ON t.XCL_030 = s.XCL_041
WHERE s.XCL_042 = 'Charter'
  AND s.XCL_044 IN ('Active', 'Closed')
  AND s.XCL_045 IN (SELECT s2.XCL_045 FROM schools s2 WHERE s2.XCL_070 = 'SSS')
  AND CAST(t.XCL_040 AS REAL) / t.XCL_036 > 0.25
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate DESC

SELECT 
    s.XCL_042 AS charter_number,
    s.XCL_043 AS school_name,
    s.XCL_044 AS county,
    f.XCL_019 AS eligible_free_rate
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.XCL_041 = f.XCL_001
JOIN satscores sat ON s.XCL_041 = sat.XCL_030
WHERE 
    s.XCL_045 IN ('Active', 'Closed')
    AND s.XCL_046 = 'Charter'
    AND sat.XCL_035 > 0.25
    AND s.XCL_044 IN (
        SELECT s2.XCL_044
        FROM schools s2
        WHERE s2.XCL_047 = 'SSS'
    )
ORDER BY f.XCL_019 DESC
